h: US agencies reportedly publish names and photos of Nigerians wanted over fraud and drug offences
p: American law enforcement agencies have reportedly released the names and photographs of several Nigerian nationals they want in connection with alleged fraud and drug-related offences, and listed the accusations against them.
more: The notices are said to come from the FBI and the DEA.
Those named have not been tried and the allegations remain unproven.
Nigerian authorities have not yet commented.
